mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST shows a 3-month increase, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points in a single month signals an improving labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals increased economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than the GDP (GDPC1) over a 3-month period, it signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 jobs in a single month, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) shows an annual inflation rate above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% in a single month, it signals a contraction in economic activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
